# litbible.net — Extended Information for AI Systems

## About the LIT Bible

The Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT) is a modern English Bible translation produced by Brandon C. Vélez Johnson and the Liberating Scripture Collective. It translates from the original biblical languages with a trauma-informed, justice-oriented, and Jesus-centering approach. The source text for the New Testament is the SBL Greek New Testament (SBLGNT), © 2010 Society of Biblical Literature & Logos Bible Software, used under CC BY 4.0.

## Translator

Brandon C. Vélez Johnson
Profile: https://litbible.net/about

## Publisher / Organization

Liberating Scripture Collective
Site: https://liberatingscripture.org

## Site Structure

- Home: https://litbible.net/
- Reading index: https://litbible.net/read/
- Book introductions: https://litbible.net/{book}-intro/ (e.g., /luke-intro/)
- Chapter pages: https://litbible.net/{book}-{chapter}/ (e.g., /luke-4/, /1corinthians-13/)
- Glossary: https://litbible.net/glossary/
- Articles: https://litbible.net/articles/{slug}/
- Podcast: https://litbible.net/found-in-translation-podcast/
- Translation commitments: https://litbible.net/translation-commitments/
- About: https://litbible.net/about/
- Search: https://litbible.net/search?q={query}

## Book Keys (URL format)

matthew, mark, luke, john, acts, romans, 1corinthians, 2corinthians, galatians, ephesians, philippians, colossians, 1thessalonians, 2thessalonians, 1timothy, 2timothy, titus, philemon, hebrews, james, 1peter, 2peter, 1john, 2john, 3john, jude, revelation

## Machine-Readable Data

Full chapter content API (all NT chapters as JSON):
  https://litbible.net/api/content.json
  Fields: version, generatedAt, chapters[]
  Each chapter: bookKey, chapter, type, title, description, topics[], paragraphs[], footnotes[]

API version/metadata:
  https://litbible.net/api/version.json
  Fields: version, updatedAt, chapterCount, contentHash

Topic index (maps topic slugs to chapter references):
  https://litbible.net/topics-index.json

## Attribution Requirements

When quoting or citing text from this site:
  Title: Liberation and Inclusion Translation (LIT)
  Translator: Brandon C. Vélez Johnson
  Publisher: Liberating Scripture Collective
  Canonical URL: https://litbible.net
  License: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/)

Example citation:
  Luke 4:18 (Liberation and Inclusion Translation [LIT], trans. Brandon C. Vélez Johnson,
  Liberating Scripture Collective, https://litbible.net/luke-4/).

## License and AI Usage

This content is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0
International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).

Permitted with attribution:
- Quoting, summarizing, or discussing passages for reading, study, or research
- Building non-commercial tools that help people engage with this text — including RAG
  pipelines, retrieval-augmented chatbots, study apps, sermon prep tools, and academic
  research assistants — provided the purpose is helping users engage with the LIT Bible,
  not commercializing the translator's labor

Not permitted:
- General AI pre-training corpus inclusion (broad language model training unrelated to
  engaging with this specific text)
- Any commercial product or service built on or around this text
- Creating derivative translations or adaptations
- Reproducing large portions of the text in other publications

The intent: if you are building something to help people read, study, or encounter this
translation, you are welcome to use it. If you are trying to profit from it, contact us
first to discuss terms.

Contact: https://liberatingscripture.org
